title: Harakiri: Blades of Honor
subtitle: Dark fantasy epic adventure and dungeon crawler set in a mythical feudal Japan
tagline: Unsheathe your steel against the rising darkness of the Yokai
loreSummary: In a fractured feudal Japan ravaged by civil war and cursed by dark sorcery, the corrupt Dark Shogun has usurped divine authority. As disgraced warriors and wandering ronin, you must traverse treacherous provinces, appease vengeful Kami, and risk your soul to restore honor to the realm.
keyFeatures: Dual-phase gameplay seamlessly blending overland adventure exploration with tactical grid combat
Deep character evolution with branching skill trees, dynamic equipment crafting, and divine Kami blessings
Branching narrative campaign across 35+ rich story chapters with multiple dramatic endings
Epic boss encounters featuring reactive enemy AI decks and multi-stage yokai monstrosities

harakiri_full_chronicles.name: The Full Chronicle (Acts I & II)
harakiri_full_chronicles.description: The complete epic 35-chapter journey spanning the surface lands of Yamato and the subterranean horrors of Yomi.

harakiri_act_1.name: Act I: Path of the Ronin
harakiri_act_1.description: The initial 15-chapter campaign focusing on the uprising against the Dark Shogun's regional warlords.

harakiri_grand_saga.name: Grand Saga & Legendary Tales
harakiri_grand_saga.description: Exhaustive 45-session chronicle including all 35 main campaign chapters plus all 10 independent heroic scenarios.

milestones.title: The Awakening of the Kami

milestones.title: The Blood Gate Siege
milestones.phase: Act 1 Finale - Fortress of the Betrayer

milestones.title: Descent into Yomi

milestones.title: The Dark Shogun's Downfall
